description: This PHP source file provides functions for handling XML data, including loading XML files securely, exporting data to XML format, and parsing XML objects into structured arrays. It also contains comments about XML External Entity (XXE) attacks and related security considerations.

methods.name: simplexml_load_file_wrapper
methods.description: Loads an XML file securely by disabling external entity loading, parses the XML content, and handles errors with internal libxml error handling.

methods.name: exportDataToXML
methods.description: Exports an array of items to an XML string based on provided templates and element information, optionally including an XML header.

methods.name: getItemsFromSimpleXMLObj
methods.description: Converts a SimpleXML object into an array of structured items based on specified element and attribute structure, applying type conversions and processing functions.
